en-US.longDescription: In a perfect world, you would want the computers in your environment to be protected from malicious Removable Media incidents while still allowing proper use of them as productivity aids. This is where secRMM comes in. secRMM protects your data from unauthorized use by employees and hackers alike.
en-US.name: secRMM

zh-CN.description: 安全可移动媒体管理器。
zh-CN.longDescription: 在理想的情况下，您既希望环境中的计算机免受恶意可移动介质事件的影响，又希望能够将其作为生产力辅助工具正常使用。这正是 secRMM 的用武之地。secRMM 可以保护您的数据免受员工和黑客的未经授权使用。
